Duke Energy (DUK) Position Boosted by Maryland Capital Management; Davide Leone & Partners Investment Company Llp Stake in Colgate Palmolive Co (CL) Has Lifted by $7.10 Million
June 1, 2018 - By Russell Anderson
Davide Leone & Partners Investment Company Llp increased its stake in Colgate Palmolive Co (CL) by 17.67% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Davide Leone & Partners Investment Company Llp bought 100,000 shares as the company’s stock declined 10.30% with the market. The institutional investor held 665,789 shares of the package goods and cosmetics company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $47.72 million, up from 565,789 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Davide Leone & Partners Investment Company Llp who had been investing in Colgate Palmolive Co for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $54.76B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.51% or $0.32 during the last trading session, reaching $62.77. About 2.01M shares traded. Colgate-Palmolive Company (NYSE:CL) has declined 15.42% since June 1, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 27.99% the S&P500.
Maryland Capital Management increased its stake in Duke Energy Corp (DUK) by 11.18% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Maryland Capital Management bought 6,885 shares as the company’s stock declined 2.71% with the market. The institutional investor held 68,463 shares of the power generation company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $5.30 million, up from 61,578 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Maryland Capital Management who had been investing in Duke Energy Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $53.11 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.81% or $1.39 during the last trading session, reaching $75.77. About 1.35 million shares traded. Duke Energy Corporation (NYSE:DUK) has declined 10.96% since June 1, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 23.53% the S&P500.
Among 20 analysts covering Duke Energy ( NYSE:DUK ), 5 have Buy rating, 4 Sell and 11 Hold. Therefore 25% are positive. Duke Energy had 89 analyst reports since August 7, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The firm earned “Neutral” rating on Thursday, October 12 by JP Morgan. On Tuesday, November 22 the stock rating was downgraded by Bank of America to “Underperform”. Morgan Stanley maintained the stock with “Equal-Weight” rating in Thursday, March 8 report. The stock of Duke Energy Corporation (NYSE:DUK) earned “Hold” rating by SunTrust on Tuesday, December 26. The rating was maintained by SunTrust on Monday, March 5 with “Hold”. Howard Weil initiated the shares of DUK in report on Tuesday, November 17 with “Sector Perform” rating. As per Sunday, August 27, the company rating was maintained by RBC Capital Markets. The rating was maintained by Deutsche Bank with “Hold” on Friday, August 7. Deutsche Bank maintained Duke Energy Corporation (NYSE:DUK) rating on Friday, November 6. Deutsche Bank has “Hold” rating and $74 target. As per Monday, February 5, the company rating was maintained by SunTrust.
